
# Loop

## Grid for factorial design

In case there are more combinations being explored

```{r}
# grid of combinations
grid=expand.grid(ntrt=c(20,30,40),nctrl=c(90,120,150))
n_reps=1000
tasks=grid[rep(1:nrow(grid),each=n_reps),]
tasks$rep=rep(1:n_reps,times=nrow(grid))
total_steps=nrow(tasks)
# register components to run in parallel
registerDoFuture()
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores()-1)
handlers("txtprogressbar")
registerDoRNG(181299)
# run loop
with_progress({
  # define number of steps
  p=progressor(steps = total_steps)
  # define results object
  results=foreach(t=1:nrow(tasks), .combine = rbind,
                     .packages = c("survival","MatchIt","boot","dplyr","smd","WeighIt",
                                   "optmatch","lpSolve","randomForest"),
                     .export = c("trt","untrt","matching","bootiptw","gcomp","dre")) %dopar% {
      # define number of treated and untreated
      ntrti=tasks$ntrt[t]
      nctrli=tasks$nctrl[t]
      # print to see where we are
      p(sprintf("ntrt=%d, nctrl=%d, i=%d",ntrti,nctrli,tasks$rep[t]))
      # sample population
      dftrial = rbind(trt[sample(1:nrow(trt), ntrti),],
                       untrt[sample(1:nrow(untrt), nctrli),]) %>%
        mutate(event=ifelse(timetotal>365,0,1),
               timetotal=ifelse(timetotal>365,365,timetotal))

        # smd before
        smdageb=smd(dftrial$ageonset,dftrial$trt)$estimate
        smdsexb=smd(dftrial$sex,dftrial$trt)$estimate
        # exact matching
        ## match
        matched=matching(data=dftrial,treatment=trt,ageofonset=ageonset,sex=sex,
                       duration=NULL,time=timetotal,method='greedy',
                       caliper=0.5,step=0.1,maxcaliper=0.5,ratio=2,
                       replacement=F,history=F,warning=F)
        ## extract dataset
        matcheddf=matched$dataset
        ## run model
        model=coxph(Surv(timetotal,event)~trt+calendar,
                    data=matcheddf,robust=T,cluster=cluster)
        ## append quantities
        res_exact=data.frame(beta=coefficients(model)[1], 
                             se=sqrt(diag(vcov(model)))[1],
                             method="exact",
                             smdageb=smdageb,
                             smdsexb=smdsexb,
                             smdagea=smd(matcheddf$ageonset,
                                         matcheddf$trt)$estimate,
                             smdsexa=smd(matcheddf$sex,
                                         matcheddf$trt)$estimate,
                             ntrt=table(matcheddf$trt)[2],
                             nctrl=table(matcheddf$trt)[1]) %>% 
          mutate(ess=ntrt+nctrl)
        # propensity score matching
        ## match
        matched=matchit(trt~ageonset+sex,
                      ratio=2,
                      #method='optimal',
                      caliper=NULL,
                      #exact=~ageonset,
                      dftrial)
        ## extract dataset
        matcheddf=match.data(matched) %>% mutate(cluster=subclass)
        ## run model
        model=coxph(Surv(timetotal,event)~trt+calendar,
                    data=matcheddf,robust=T,cluster=subclass)
        ## append quantities
        res_psm=data.frame(beta=coefficients(model)[1],
                           se=sqrt(diag(vcov(model)))[1], 
                           method="psm",
                           smdageb=smdageb,
                           smdsexb=smdsexb,
                           smdagea=smd(matcheddf$ageonset,
                                       matcheddf$trt)$estimate,
                           smdsexa=smd(matcheddf$sex,
                                       matcheddf$trt)$estimate,
                           ntrt=table(matcheddf$trt)[2],
                           nctrl=table(matcheddf$trt)[1]) %>% 
          mutate(ess=ntrt+nctrl)
        # iptw
        weights=iptw(data=dftrial,type='stabilised',estimand='ATT',
                   formula=trt~ageonset+sex)
        # dataset
        dfmw=weights$data
        ## point estimate and standard error
        boot_res=boot(data=dftrial,
                    statistic=bootiptw,
                    #parallel="snow", ncpus=parallel::detectCores()-1,
                    R=500,
                    trt_model=list(formula=trt~ageonset+sex,
                                   type='stabilised',
                                   estimand='ATT',
                                   truncate=NULL,
                                   distance='glm',
                                   tune=FALSE),
                    outcome_model=list(formula=Surv(timetotal,event)~trt+calendar,
                                       treatment='trt'))
        ## append quantities
        res_iptw=data.frame(beta=boot_res$t0, 
                            se=sd(boot_res$t), 
                            method="iptw",
                            smdageb=smdageb,
                            smdsexb=smdsexb,
                            smdagea=smd(dfmw$ageonset,
                                        dfmw$trt,
                                        w=dfmw$w)$estimate,
                            smdsexa=smd(dfmw$sex,
                                        dfmw$trt,
                                        w=dfmw$w)$estimate,
                            ntrt=sum(dfmw$w[dfmw$trt==1]),
                            nctrl=sum(dfmw$w[dfmw$trt==0]),
                            ess=ESS(dfmw$w))
        # append all quantities
        out=rbind(res_exact, res_psm, res_iptw)
        out$ntrt_pool=ntrti
        out$nctrl_pool=nctrli
        out
                     }
})
```

# Save quantities

```{r}
results=results %>% 
  mutate(truth=log(0.6),
         hr=exp(beta),
         lower=beta-1.96*se,
         upper=beta+1.96*se)
```
